visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Fill a Table Instead of Recursing
visualizerParams.problemDescription: A plain recursive function computes the LCS and repeats the same sub-problems many times. Fill a table of sub-results. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: The recursion branches twice at every mismatch, so its running time is exponential in the string lengths. The table solves each pair of prefixes once, which takes n times m steps.
